title: Type Definitions
description: Define types, interfaces, unions, and enums in GraphQL.

data.text: GraphQL has a rich type system. Hot Chocolate maps C# types to GraphQL types automatically, but you can fine-tune the mapping with attributes.
Object types are the building blocks of your schema. Each public property becomes a field.

data.title: Object Types

data.text: Interfaces let you define common fields that multiple types share. Use `[InterfaceType]` on the interface and `[ImplementInterface]` on implementations.

data.title: Interface Example
data.content: A Media interface shared by Book and Movie.

data.text: Unions allow a field to return one of several types. Use `[UnionType]` and `[UnionMember]`.

data.title: Union Example
data.content: A search result that can be a Book or Author.

data.text: Enums map directly to GraphQL enum types. Use `[EnumType]` for customization.

data.title: Enum Example

terms.definition: A type that defines fields other types must implement.
A type that can be one of several object types.
A type with a fixed set of allowed values.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: C# classes map to GraphQL object types
Unions let a field return different types
Enums restrict values to a known set
data.takeaway: Next, we'll learn about input types for mutations.
